test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If sin A = (4)/(5) and sin B = (15)/(17), what is the value of sin (A - B)?
solution:
**Given:**

sin A = (4)/(5) and sin B = (15)/(17)

**Concept used:**

sin (A - B) = sinAcosB - cosAsinB

**Calculation:**

sin A = (4)/(5)

So, cos A = (3)/(5)

Again,

sin B = (15)/(17)

So, cos B = (8)/(17)

Now,

sin (A - B) = sinAcosB - cosAsinB

⇒ (4)/(5) × (8)/(17) - (3)/(5) × (15)/(17)

⇒ (32)/(85) - (45)/(85)

⇒ - (13)/(85)

**∴ The required answer is -(13)/(85).**
